evasion_targets: ST-01 trusted-owner short-circuit for a genuine Electron owner started by an untrusted launcher (review of the 1.1.7 integration, M3)
notes: An unsigned launcher in Temp starts the genuine Exodus.exe with no argument and pipes its script on stdin (ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1). The command line is plain, so only the launcher tells: the Exodus wallet files read by an Exodus started from an untrusted process are not owner reads.
